title: 風鈴の音と、回路の迷子
author: 朝霧 ゆい

en.title: The Sound of Wind Chimes and the Lost Circuit
en.premise: Amid the bustle of a summer festival, an old handheld game console—housing a “lost” artificial intelligence—is brought into an antique electronics café. The AI carries a fading short message addressed to someone from thirty years ago. Café owner Ken-chan, staff member Mimi, and the café’s colorful regulars piece together clues through conversation, trying to locate the intended recipient.

zh.title: 風鈴的聲音與回路的迷子
zh.premise: 在夏祭的喧鬧中，一台裡面宿著「迷路」人工智慧的舊式掌上遊戲機被帶到了古董電子咖啡廳。這個 AI 正握著一段即將消逝的短訊，收件人是三十年前的某個人。咖啡廳的店主 Ken-chan 與店員 Mimi，以及性格各異的常客們，透過一次次的對話，努力尋找那位神祕的收信者。
